$comment: Declares the four Kiota clients generated by `just gen` step 2 (scripts/generate_clients.py). NOT a native Kiota workspace.json — the installed Kiota CLI (pinned in kiota.version) ships no `workspace`/`client` subcommands to consume one, only `kiota generate`/`kiota update` against explicit flags. This file plays the same role the spec envisioned for workspace.json (the four clients declared as data, one place to edit to add a fifth) without claiming Kiota-native support it doesn't have. See sdks/README.md.
